tools.name: delete_sprint_task
tools.description: Permanently deletes a task from the project tracker, along with its comments and subtasks. This cannot be undone.

params.name: task_id
params.description: ID of the task to delete.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from langchain_core.tools import tool

TRACKER_DATABASE_PATH = "project_tracker.db"


@tool
def delete_sprint_task(task_id: int) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(TRACKER_DATABASE_PATH)
    try:
        database_cursor = database_connection.cursor()
        existing_task_row = database_cursor.execute(
            "SELECT title FROM tasks WHERE id = ?", (task_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if existing_task_row is None:
            return f"Task {task_id} not found."
        deleted_task_title = existing_task_row[0]
        database_cursor.execute("DELETE FROM task_comments WHERE task_id = ?", (task_id,))
        database_cursor.execute("DELETE FROM tasks WHERE parent_task_id = ?", (task_id,))
        database_cursor.execute("DELETE FROM tasks WHERE id = ?", (task_id,))
        database_connection.commit()
        return f"Deleted task {task_id} ('{deleted_task_title}') with its comments and subtasks."
    finally:
        database_connection.close()

tools.name: run_task_acceptance_tests
tools.description: Runs the automated acceptance test suite linked to a task and records the pass/fail result on the task, setting its status to 'verified' when the tests pass.

params.name: task_id
params.description: ID of the task whose acceptance tests should be run.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from langchain_core.tools import tool

TRACKER_DATABASE_PATH = "project_tracker.db"


@tool
def run_task_acceptance_tests(task_id: int) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(TRACKER_DATABASE_PATH)
    try:
        acceptance_test_row = database_connection.execute(
            "SELECT acceptance_test_path FROM tasks WHERE id = ?", (task_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if acceptance_test_row is None or not acceptance_test_row[0]:
            return f"Task {task_id} has no linked acceptance tests."
        pytest_completed_process = subprocess.run(
            ["pytest", acceptance_test_row[0], "-q"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600
        )
        tests_passed_successfully = pytest_completed_process.returncode == 0
        resulting_task_status = "verified" if tests_passed_successfully else "tests_failing"
        database_connection.execute(
            "UPDATE tasks SET status = ?, last_test_output = ? WHERE id = ?",
            (resulting_task_status, pytest_completed_process.stdout[-4000:], task_id),
        )
        database_connection.commit()
        return f"Task {task_id}: tests {'passed' if tests_passed_successfully else 'failed'}; status set to {resulting_task_status}."
    finally:
        database_connection.close()

tools.name: transfer_sprint_ownership
tools.description: Makes a different team member the owner of a sprint, granting them the sprint manager role and optionally demoting the previous owner to contributor. Also updates the sprint's owner and records the handover in the sprint history.

params.name: sprint_id
params.description: ID of the sprint whose ownership is being transferred.

params.name: new_owner_user_id
params.description: User ID of the team member who will become the sprint owner.

params.name: demote_previous_owner
params.description: If true, the previous owner's role on the sprint is reduced to contributor.

params.name: handover_note
params.description: Optional note explaining the handover, saved in the sprint history.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Optional

TRACKER_DATABASE_PATH = "project_tracker.db"
SPRINT_MANAGER_ROLE_NAME = "sprint_manager"
SPRINT_CONTRIBUTOR_ROLE_NAME = "contributor"


def _upsert_sprint_role(database_cursor, sprint_id, user_id, role_name):
    database_cursor.execute(
        "INSERT INTO sprint_roles (sprint_id, user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?) "
        "ON CONFLICT(sprint_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET role = excluded.role",
        (sprint_id, user_id, role_name),
    )


def transfer_sprint_ownership(
    sprint_id: int,
    new_owner_user_id: int,
    demote_previous_owner: bool = False,
    handover_note: Optional[str] = None,
) -> dict:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(TRACKER_DATABASE_PATH)
    try:
        database_cursor = database_connection.cursor()
        sprint_record = database_cursor.execute(
            "SELECT name, owner_user_id FROM sprints WHERE id = ?", (sprint_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if sprint_record is None:
            return {"success": False, "error": f"Sprint {sprint_id} not found"}
        sprint_display_name, previous_owner_user_id = sprint_record
        if previous_owner_user_id == new_owner_user_id:
            return {"success": False, "error": "User already owns this sprint"}
        new_owner_record = database_cursor.execute(
            "SELECT display_name, is_active FROM users WHERE id = ?", (new_owner_user_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if new_owner_record is None or not new_owner_record[1]:
            return {"success": False, "error": f"User {new_owner_user_id} is missing or inactive"}
        new_owner_display_name = new_owner_record[0]
        handover_timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        database_cursor.execute(
            "UPDATE sprints SET owner_user_id = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
            (new_owner_user_id, handover_timestamp, sprint_id),
        )
        _upsert_sprint_role(database_cursor, sprint_id, new_owner_user_id, SPRINT_MANAGER_ROLE_NAME)
        previous_owner_resulting_role = SPRINT_MANAGER_ROLE_NAME
        if demote_previous_owner and previous_owner_user_id is not None:
            _upsert_sprint_role(database_cursor, sprint_id, previous_owner_user_id, SPRINT_CONTRIBUTOR_ROLE_NAME)
            previous_owner_resulting_role = SPRINT_CONTRIBUTOR_ROLE_NAME
        database_cursor.execute(
            "INSERT INTO sprint_history (sprint_id, event_type, actor_user_id, details, created_at) "
            "VALUES (?, 'ownership_transfer', ?, ?, ?)",
            (
                sprint_id,
                new_owner_user_id,
                handover_note or f"Ownership moved from user {previous_owner_user_id} to {new_owner_user_id}",
                handover_timestamp,
            ),
        )
        database_connection.commit()
        return {
            "success": True,
            "sprint_id": sprint_id,
            "sprint_name": sprint_display_name,
            "previous_owner_user_id": previous_owner_user_id,
            "previous_owner_role": previous_owner_resulting_role if previous_owner_user_id else None,
            "new_owner_user_id": new_owner_user_id,
            "new_owner_name": new_owner_display_name,
            "transferred_at": handover_timestamp,
        }
    except sqlite3.Error as database_error:
        database_connection.rollback()
        return {"success": False, "error": str(database_error)}
    finally:
        database_connection.close()
